Add canary upgrade support (#12)

* Handle namespace labeling with istioRevision

* Move to use separate file for init

* Change the target revision for testing only

* Use separate target revision for testing

* Add kustomization patch file which would come in handy for later

* Run importer generate

* Remove usage of demo 2 specific files

* Create new directory for generated manifests

* Add patch as a separate reference

* Move full-installation to without-revision

* Run update for armadillo 1.7.8 with canary setup

* Add canary setup for bison and dolphin

* Add without-revision for bison and dolphin

* Add new script for generated manifests

* Add patch reference

* Correct IstioOperator CRs

* Add Argo sync wave for dolphin control plane

* Add generated manifests for 1.8.5 and 1.9.4

* Add canary setup based on with-generated-manifests

* Add new Argo CD App

* Correct link

* Fix typo

* Try canary for control plane

* Correct path

* Add missed file

* Correct app name

* Correct typo

* Migrate to v1.8.5 in main resources

* Add cluster name, and remove istiocoredns

* Remove pod anti affinity on istiod

* Remove affinity from v1.8.5 istiod

* Remove affinity from v1.9.4 istiod

* Remove affinity from v1.7.8 istiod

* Remove affinity from no-operator-install

* Ensure generated-manifests have the same spec as no-operator-install

* Add armadillo connection to bison

* Let Bison go to 1.8.5 fully

* Revert Istio installation for now

* Rename no-operator to generated-manifests in some places

* Update links to stick to the same branch

* Retry canary full roll out

* Add istiod service for Bison

* Try pilotCertProvider of kubernetes for Bison

* Revert pilot cert provider

* Fall back to partial canary

* Retry canary graduation

* Ensure multicluster gateway has mesh and network information

* Add mesh and cluster metadata

* Remove affinity setup from gateways

* Move to 1.8.5 for Armadillo as well

* Ensure Armadillo has mesh information for gateways

* Run istioctl manifest generate with IOP values update

* Revert to 1.7.8

* Copy current IOP to archive for 1.7.8 specific use cases

* Adjust spec for 1.7.8

* Copy for 1.7.8

* Adjust spec for 1.7.8

* Fix up 1.7.8 with no affinity

* Create a new 1.7.8 specific script

* Go for Bison release

* Update multiclutser envoyfilter definition to test

* Add clarification comment

* Adjust EnvoyFilter for Armadillo as well

* Roll out Armadillo's Gateway as well

* Revert the change

* Comment out kind config which seems unnecessary

* Correct target branch

* Revert to use single version only
